live.offline: offline — changes wait to be sent

noAccess.title: You don't have access to sample rounds
noAccess.body: Sales and the production manager see sample rounds; the planner and the quality inspector read them. Ask your administrator for one of these roles.

test.title: The notified body's result
test.body: Recorded once; whoever keeps certificates records it.
test.certificateLater: Link the certificate from the certificate's own page (Compliance › Certificates) for now.

wo.title: Make sample work order
wo.made: Work order {number} is made; the round is in making.
wo.failed: Couldn't read what the work order can be made on
wo.body: A sample work order is made on an order line of the style, from revision {revision}, with the round’s sizes.
wo.bodyNone: Without an order line, the sample work order makes the round's own sizes, from revision {revision}: it is shipped, invoiced and returned on no order.

way.noneBody: The round's own sizes: a proto, fit or salesman sample that no order pays for.
way.linesBody: The order that charges the samples: they take its sizes.

none.colourway: Colourway of the sizes without one
none.colourwayHint: The round names sizes without a colourway: say which one they are made in.

wo.takesNothing: Takes no size of the round

blocker.noLines: No confirmed order line of this style: a sample work order is made on an order line.
blocker.noLinesCustomer: No confirmed order line of this style for the round's customer: a sample work order is made on the customer's own order.
blocker.noSites: No plant where your role makes work orders.
blocker.pickLine: Choose at least one order line.
blocker.other_one: The factory names {count} reason it cannot be made now.
blocker.other_other: The factory names {count} reasons it cannot be made now.
blocker.pickColourway: Choose the colourway of the sizes without one.

warning.draft: Revision {revision} is a draft: the work order is made, and released only once the revision is released.
warning.other_one: The factory names {count} thing that may hold its release.
warning.other_other: The factory names {count} things that may hold its release.

request.newerRevision: Revision {released} is released; this round is made from revision {pinned} (pinned).
request.revisionHint: Changed only while the round is requested.
request.commentsLater: Open comments from the last round come here later.
request.styleFailed: Couldn't read the style: the sizes and colours stay as text.

change.title: Raise a change
change.body: A change request on {style}, revision {revision}, raised by this sample round.

refusal.ROUND_CLOSED: This round is decided or cancelled: it no longer changes.
refusal.SAME_STAGE: The round is already at that stage.
refusal.DECIDED_BY_DECISION: A round is decided by recording its decision (Decide…), not by moving it.
refusal.CANCEL_WITH_REASON: Cancel the round with why (⋯ › Cancel round), not by moving it.
refusal.REVISION_FROZEN: The revision is pinned: it changes only while the round is requested.
refusal.REVISION_OBSOLETE: That revision is obsolete: a sample is made from the released revision or a draft.
refusal.NO_REVISION: The style has no revision yet: start revision 1 in Products › Styles first.
refusal.STYLE_CLOSED: The style is archived or discontinued: no new samples are made of it.
refusal.CHARGE_INTERNAL: An internal round charges nobody: name the customer, or leave the charge out.
refusal.CERTIFICATION_ONLY: Only a CE test sample has this.
refusal.SHIPMENT_ROUND_CANCELLED: The round is cancelled: nothing more is sent for it.
refusal.SHIPMENT_SENT: The shipment was sent: it stays on the round.
refusal.SENT_ONCE: It was already sent: when it was sent stays as it was.
refusal.RECEIVED_ONCE: It was already received: when it arrived stays as it was.
refusal.RECEIVED_BEFORE_SENT: Mark it sent first: a shipment arrives after it was sent.
refusal.RETURN_NO_ADDRESS: A return comes back to us: it names no address of the customer.
refusal.NO_WORK_ORDER: The round is decided or cancelled: no work order is made for it.
refusal.LINE_OF_ANOTHER_PARTY: That order line is another customer's: the samples are made on the round's own customer's order.
refusal.NOTHING_MADE: Nothing is made yet: a requested round is decided once it is made or sent.
refusal.BRAND_ASKED: The customer has been asked and has not answered: withdraw the request (Activity › Approvals) before deciding here.
refusal.INTERNAL_ROUND: An internal round has no customer to ask.
refusal.NOT_REJECTED: The next round follows a rejected round only.
refusal.CERTIFICATE_NOT_COVERING: That certificate does not cover this style.
refusal.NOTHING_TO_RECORD: Choose the result or the certificate.
refusal.FIT_CLOSED: The round is decided or cancelled: its fit no longer changes.
refusal.NO_SPEC: The pinned revision has no measurement spec yet: make it in the style’s Sizes & measurements.
refusal.POINT_NOT_IN_SPEC: That point of measure has no value for this size in the spec.
refusal.SIZE_NOT_IN_ROUND: That size is not in this round.
refusal.SWATCH_NOT_SENT: Mark the swatch sent before its decision.
refusal.SWATCH_SENT: The swatch was sent: what was sent no longer changes.
refusal.SWATCH_ROUND_CANCELLED: The round is cancelled: no swatch is added to it.
refusal.SWATCH_KIND: Ask the customer with the swatch’s own kind (colour or leather).
refusal.LEATHER_ONLY: A leather swatch is of a leather.
refusal.NOT_THE_ROUNDS_PARTY: The swatch goes to the round's own customer.
refusal.NO_COMPANY: A swatch of a shared style with no round cannot be asked of the customer: ask on a round’s swatch, or decide it here.
refusal.other: The factory refused it as it is.
refusal.ORDER_LINE_NEEDED: This round is made on an order line: only a proto, fit or salesman round that charges nobody is made without one.

problem.unavailable: The factory didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not reach this.
problem.notFound: It is not there any more.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.contract: This page and the factory disagree: reload the page.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries: wait a minute.
problem.stale: Someone changed it first: it was read again.
problem.invalid: Some of what was typed was refused.
problem.writeForbidden: Your role does not allow this here.
problem.stepUp: This asks for your authenticator code first.

held.decided: The round is decided: it no longer moves.
held.cancelled: The round is cancelled: it no longer moves.
held.decideNotDrag: Decided only by its decision: press d or Decide… on the card.
held.noManage: Your role can view sample rounds, not change them.
held.noDecide: Your role cannot decide on samples.
held.noMeasure: Your role cannot measure the fit.
held.noRight: Your role does not allow it.
held.offline: Offline — this waits until the network is back.
held.offlineKept: Offline — your changes are kept on this page.

hint.OPEN: Every round not decided or cancelled
hint.LATE: Open rounds past their due day

list.intro: Proto, fit, salesman, pre-production and CE test sample rounds, each pinned to a style revision, on one board.
list.noMatchBody: Clear the filters to see every round.
list.emptyBody: A round asks for a proto, fit, salesman or CE test sample of a style revision.
list.foot: Earliest due first. A cancelled round is in the list, not on the board.
list.footMore: Showing the first 200 rounds: narrow the filters to see the rest.

board.readOnly: Your role can view the board, not move cards.

new.title: New sample request
new.styleHint: The style the samples are made of.
new.revisionHint: The round is made from this revision and stays pinned to it.
new.roundNoHint: Empty: the next round of this type.
new.customerHint: Internal: a round for us, charged to nobody.
new.customerNoRight: Your role does not read customers: the round is internal or the style's brand.
new.chargeHint: A price: what the customer pays for these samples.
new.noSizes: The style has no size range yet.
new.pickStyleFirst: Choose a style to see its colourways and sizes.
new.testZones: Sizes and zones for the notified body
new.testZonesHint: What is sent for testing (a CE test sample only).

held.roundNo: The round number is a whole number from 1 to {max}.
held.cells: Type at least one piece in a colour and size.
held.tooManyCells: At most {max} colour and size cells.
held.charge: Type the charge as an amount (95 or 95,50).

decide.title: Decide on the sample
decide.commentsFieldHint: Say why for "with comments" and "rejected": they go to the next round.
decide.approvedHint: The sample is right as it is.
decide.commentsHint: Approved, with the changes said in the comments.
decide.rejectedHint: Not approved: a next round follows.
decide.subject: {number} · {kind} · round {n}

record.notFoundBody: It may be of another company, or the address is wrong.
record.offline: Offline — the round as last read; every change waits.

activity.none: Nothing yet. The first change or message appears here.
activity.noRight: Your role does not read the round's messages and history.

sample.noneBody: The samples are made on the floor through a sample work order, like any other work order.
sample.laterTitle: Materials, minutes and where the sample is come later
sample.laterBody: For now the work order's own page has its materials and progress.
sample.held_one: {count} more at a plant you do not see
sample.held_other: {count} more at plants you do not see

fit.title: Measured against spec
fit.measuredTip: Size {size}: the value measured on the sample
fit.emptyBody: The spec has no point for these sizes yet.
fit.hint: Type a value, or paste a column from a sheet; each cell saves alone. A comma or a point is the decimal sign.
fit.notNumber: Size {size}: «{text}» is not a number — the value stays.

comment.noPoint: None (a body area or the whole sample)
comment.areaHint: Where on the garment (collar, left cuff…).

approval.byPortal: {name} for the customer, in the portal (signed {signed})
approval.asked: The customer was asked {when}; the answer is due {due}.
approval.request: The last request to the customer: {status} ({when}).
approval.internal: An internal round is decided in the office.
approval.ceOnly: Only a CE test sample goes to a notified body.
approval.noSwatches: No swatch sent for this round.
approval.swatchHint: A swatch is decided once it is sent: here, or by the customer when asked.

ship.cellFailed: Not saved: see the notice above.
ship.title: Shipments
ship.noneBody: Add the shipment to {name} with its courier and tracking.
ship.noneInternal: An internal round may still go to a notified body or an agent.
ship.hint: A cell saves alone. Sent and received are set once each; an outbound shipment sent moves the round to Sent, received to Under review.
ship.internalParty: An internal round has no customer: the shipment needs one (a notified body or an agent), which the factory asks for.

problem.url: A tracking page starts with https://.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}?
cancel.body: A cancelled round stays in the list with why; its work orders stay as they are.

next.title: Make the next round
next.body: The same style, type, customer and sizes as {number}, from the newest revision; the rejection’s words become its instructions.
